title: AE51018: Industrial Aerodynamics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: AE21001
3 - 0 - 0: 3 CreditsHistorical background,
wind-data, basic shape factors, bluff body aerodynamics, Wind tunnels and
measurement techniques, Dynamic effects, aeroelastic phenomena, Application to
buildings, chimneys, towers, bridges, automobiles, etc; Design practice, case
studies.

Concepts taught in class

Student Opinion
The course description in ERP is misleading. The course should be called Meteorology. There isn't even any aerodynamics involved and the class is boring beyond measure.
